description: pac solution import into the target environment using the deployment settings file, then publish every Copilot Studio agent from the solution. Source: a zip, or a solutionDir from cs_pull_solution (managed zip preferred when present unless unmanaged: true), or an unpacked srcFolder (packed first). Blocks when connection references or environment variables are unmapped unless allowUnmapped. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

publishAgents.description: Default true: pac copilot publish for each agent after import

srcFolder.description: Unpacked solution folder to pack and deploy

targetEnvironment.description: Environment id or URL to deploy into

unmanaged.description: With solutionDir: deploy the unmanaged zip instead of the managed one

name: cs_deploy_solution
title: Deploy a solution to another environment (1:1)
